items.title: Moore Named MW Freshman of the Week
items.summary: LAS VEGAS - North Dakota State cornerback Marion Moore was named Old Trapper Mountain West Freshman of the Week on Monday, Nov. 2, by the conference office. It is Moore's second award of the season.

items.title: North Dakota State Defeats UTEP, 31-7
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. - Nathan Hayes passed for 240 yards and North Dakota State forced three turnovers en route to a 31-7 victory over UTEP in Mountain West football Saturday, Oct. 31, before a crowd of 15,513 at Gate City Bank Field at the Fargodome.

items.title: Bison Host UTEP Saturday in First Halloween Home Game Since 1981
items.summary: THIS WEEK: The North Dakota State football team is back home in Mountain West Conference play this week when the Bison (6-2, 3-2 MW) take on the UTEP Miners (1-6, 0-3 MW) at 2:35 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, at Gate City Bank Field at the Fargodome (18,700). items.title: New Mexico Defeats North Dakota State, 21-16
items.summary: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. - Austin Brawley's 56-yard interception return for touchdown in the fourth quarter held up as the winning score in New Mexico's 21-16 victory over North Dakota State on Saturday, Oct. 24, before a crowd of 34,794 at University Stadium.

items.title: Polasek Named to Bear Bryant Coach of the Year Watch List
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. - Third-year North Dakota State head football coach Tim Polasek was named to the watch list for the Paul "Bear" Bryant National Coach of the Year Award on Wednesday, Oct. 21.

items.title: Bison Travel to New Mexico to Face First-Place Lobos Saturday Night on The CW
items.summary: THIS WEEK: The North Dakota State football team goes back on the road in the Mountain West this week when the Bison (6-1, 3-1 MW) take on the first-place New Mexico Lobos (5-1, 2-0 MW) at 8:10 p.m. MT on Saturday, Oct. 24, at University Stadium (37,440) in Albuquerque.

items.title: Williams, Moore Named MW Football Players of the Week
items.summary: LAS VEGAS - North Dakota State's Jackson Williams and Marion Moore were named Old Trapper Mountain West Football Players of the Week by the conference office Monday, Oct. 19, for their performances in NDSU's 31-17 win over Nevada.

items.title: Bison Bowl-Eligible After Beating Nevada 31-17
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. - North Dakota State is bowl-eligible in its first year as a Football Bowl Subdivision member after securing its sixth victory 31-17 over Nevada on Saturday, Oct. 17, before a crowd of 18,261 at Gate City Bank Field at the Fargodome.

items.title: Schmidt Added to Rimington Trophy Watch List
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. - North Dakota State's Gage Schmidt on Thursday, Oct. 15, was added to the watch list for the Rimington Trophy, presented annually to the most outstanding center in NCAA FBS football.

items.title: North Dakota State Hosts Nevada Saturday Night on CBS Sports Network
items.summary: THIS WEEK: The North Dakota State football team is back at home this week when the Bison (5-1, 2-1 MW) host the Nevada Wolf Pack (2-3, 1-1 MW) at 6 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 17, at Gate City Bank Field at the Fargodome (18,700).
